event_name: Date 12 June 2022 Time 16:41 2022 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 June 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed multiple angles of video evidence and GPS data. Car 6 was shown the blue flag on multiple occasions and the blue lights were displayed for 12 panels, between turns 7 and the finish line, prior to car 10 being able to pass.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 6 Ignoring Blue Flags
